about.title: About
about.description: The first board game company built entirely in the open. CC BY-SA rules, MIT engines, forkable rulebooks in git. Founded in Kuala Lumpur, incorporated in the UK.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Our public 18-month roadmap. Physical production, online engines, marketplace, and community tools.

community.title: Community
community.description: Join the Moddable.Games community on Discord. Playtesters, designers, and rule-tinkerers building open-source board games together.

press.title: Press Kit
press.description: Moddable.Games press kit. Logos, screenshots, brand colours, and contact details for editorial use.

team.title: Team
team.description: Meet the team behind Moddable.Games. Four people building open-source board games.

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.description: Get updates on new mods, games, and tools from Moddable.Games.

submit.title: Submit a Mod
submit.description: Submit your board game mod to the Moddable.Games library. Open to all designers.

developers.title: Developers
developers.description: Build on Moddable engines. APIs, SDKs, and embeddable game tools for developers.

engine.title: The Engine
engine.description: 133 playable variants across 6 game families. Pure ES modules, MIT licensed, zero dependencies. Chess, Draughts, Go, Shogi, Xiangqi, Reversi.

mods.title: Mods
mods.description: Browse our library of open-source rulebook mods for board games you already own.

games.title: Games
games.description: Original games designed to be modded from day one — Nukes, Planet Mongo, Endless Skies.

engines.title: Engines
engines.description: Open-source game engines anyone can embed, extend, or fork. Moddable Chess and Moddable Hexmaps.

news.title: News
news.description: Essays, announcements, and build logs from Moddable.Games. Written by humans, for humans.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Free digital tools for tabletop play. Dice rollers, deck builders, map generators, and more.

tools-ti.title: Twilight Imperium tools
tools-ti.description: Twilight Imperium tools — faction picker, objective tracker, agenda voter.

tools-talisman.title: Talisman tools
tools-talisman.description: Talisman Worlds tools — character lottery, hex board generator, encounter quick-draw.

tools-nukes.title: Nukes tools
tools-nukes.description: Nukes game tools — hex map generator, combat calculator, and hostage tracker for the hex strategy game.

tools-dice.title: Dice Lab
tools-dice.description: Dice roller and battle simulator. Roll any dice, or simulate combat for Risk, TI4, Axis & Allies, X-Wing, Blood Bowl, and Memoir '44.

tools-decks.title: Card Deck Builder
tools-decks.description: Card deck builder — design, shuffle, and deal custom card decks for any tabletop game.

tools-chess.title: Chess Variant Explorer
tools-chess.description: {{counts.chess_variants}} chess variants with 5 AI difficulty levels. Play in-browser, solve puzzles, explore opening books.

tools-oracles.title: Oracles
tools-oracles.description: RPG oracle tools for 10 systems: Starforged, Ironsworn, Maze Rats, Cairn, D&D 5e, Pathfinder, Dungeon World, Knave, BRP, Fate Core.

home.full_title: Moddable.Games — Creating games you already own
home.description: The first board game company built entirely in the open. CC-licensed rulebooks, forkable engines, and original games designed to be taken apart.
